set_all_non_lazy_fields: set all non-lazy fields of a protobuf TestAllTypes message to unique test values
set_all_fields: set all fields including lazy ones of a protobuf TestAllTypes message to unique test values
set_all_extensions: set all extension fields of a protobuf TestAllExtensions message to unique test values
expect_all_fields_set: verify all fields of a protobuf message have the expected values after SetAllFields is called
set_all_packed_fields: set all packed repeated fields of a protobuf TestPackedTypes message to unique test values
